name: Tibni
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Israel is divided: half follow Tibni son of Ginath and half follow Omri, but Omri's followers prevail, Tibni dies, and Omri reigns.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship
